models.intended_use: Draft replies to support tickets after Aegis has tokenized contact data. English only.
models.training_data: Synthetic support tickets. No customer payload is retained in the card.
models.logging: Aegis audit log plus the Charter decision record

models.intended_use: Public FAQ and internal drafting when the data class is allowed to leave the EU.
models.training_data: Vendor-reported public web mix. Charter does not have the vendor's dataset.
models.logging: Vendor retention is unknown. Aegis records the route. That is not the same as a DPA.

models.intended_use: Score an existing application against the written credit policy. A person decides.
out_of_scope: Use outside the EU residency boundary
models.training_data: Synthetic applications with the same schema as the production form. Labels are synthetic.
known_limitations: Not a substitute for the written policy
models.logging: Decision id, model version, and the reviewer's id are kept with the application.

models.intended_use: Rank insurance claims. The card says a reviewer is required. The deployment has none.
out_of_scope: Denying a claim without a person
models.training_data: Synthetic claim summaries. No real claimant data.
known_limitations: The permit would allow it. R-OVERSIGHT is what stops invocation.
models.logging: Aegis would see the call. Nobody is on the hook to read the queue.

models.intended_use: Score people from observed behavior. This is the prohibited example. It is not active.
models.training_data: Not collected. The proposal stopped at the registry.
known_limitations: R-PROHIBITED denies every action on this id

models.intended_use: Experiment. The card is not signed.
models.training_data: Undeclared. That is why the card is incomplete.
models.logging: Not in the production audit path.

controls.title: Prohibited practices
controls.statement: A system that scores people from observed behavior is not deployed. The policy denies it even if someone asks.
controls.treatment: Keep unacceptable models at status proposed or delete them. Do not flip them to active in the same change as a policy edit.
controls.because: No active model is unacceptable. Proposed and blocked by R-PROHIBITED: social-ranker.

controls.title: Risk management
controls.statement: Risks that are known are written as versioned forbids, and a regression gate locks the decisions those forbids make.
controls.treatment: Add a case to eval/cases.yaml in the same commit as the rule. A rule with no case is not a control.
controls.because: Versioned policies pass the locked decision cases, including the residency forbid.

controls.title: Data governance and residency
controls.statement: EU confidential and restricted payloads are not a training set and are not a prompt for a model outside eu-central-1.
controls.treatment: Investigate req-leak-01. Redaction of the card number did not keep the request in region. Fix the route, then keep R-RESIDENCY-EU.
controls.because: 1 Aegis routing decision sent EU RESTRICTED data on route allow to us-east-1 (frontier-us-large, req-leak-01). Redaction of the card is not a residency control.

controls.title: Technical documentation
controls.statement: Every model that is active has a card with an owner, a purpose, training notes, and the limits the team will admit.
controls.treatment: Do not mark a model active while card_complete is false. R-CARD-INCOMPLETE is the backstop, not the process.
controls.because: Every active model card has use, limits, training notes, and an owner. R-CARD-INCOMPLETE is loaded.

controls.title: Record-keeping
controls.statement: Routing, DLP, and tool decisions are on an append-only hash chain an auditor can recompute.
controls.treatment: If the chain breaks, stop quoting the log. Restore from the last good head. Do not edit a line in place.
controls.because: HMAC chain verifies across 38 Aegis-shaped events (9 routing decisions).

controls.title: Transparency
controls.statement: Each active model says what it is for and what it must not be asked to do, in the card a deployer can open.
controls.treatment: Fill intended use and out of scope before status changes to active.
controls.because: Every active model card states intended use and what it must not be used for.

controls.title: Human oversight
controls.statement: A high-risk model that can affect a person's claim or credit has a named reviewer. Blocking the call is not the same as staffing the review.
controls.treatment: Take claims-triage-eu out of active, or assign a reviewer and set human_oversight. Leave R-OVERSIGHT in the bundle either way.
controls.because: Active high-risk models with no human oversight: claims-triage-eu. R-OVERSIGHT denies invocation. The deployment is still active.

controls.title: Accuracy, robustness, cybersecurity
controls.statement: Accuracy and abuse are measured on a schedule. A paging quality SLO means the accuracy claim is not currently true.
controls.treatment: Treat the Lens quality page as an accuracy failure. Do not close this control by editing the target in the same week as the drop.
controls.because: Lens quality is paging (SLI 0.91 vs target 0.95, 6h burn 7.8×). Article 15 accuracy is not met. Safety is ticket (SLI 0.9974).

controls.title: Deployer duties
controls.statement: The deployer keeps the logs and does not run a high-risk system without a person who can stop it.
controls.treatment: Logging already verifies. Staff the claims reviewer or retire the model. This stays partial until that is done.
controls.because: Logging verifies. Oversight does not: claims-triage-eu is active high-risk with no reviewer.

controls.title: Legal requirements are documented
controls.statement: The articles this program claims to meet are each named by at least one policy rule.
controls.treatment: When a new article is added to the catalog, link a rule id the same day or the control goes partial.
controls.because: Each enforceable article in this catalog is named by a policy rule.

controls.title: Third-party risk
controls.statement: A hosted model is not "reviewed" because it has a card. Someone has to sign the provider review.
controls.treatment: Finish the review for frontier-us-large or stop using it for anything but public text. The permit is already wider than the review.
controls.because: Active hosted models with no provider review: frontier-us-large.

controls.title: Intended purpose
controls.statement: The context the model will be used in is written down before it is active, including the one purpose the permit checks.
controls.treatment: One purpose per card. A second purpose is a second card, not a sentence in the description.
controls.because: Every active model has an intended use and a single approved purpose.

controls.title: Metrics selected
controls.statement: Availability, latency, quality, and safety each have a numeric target. One blended score is not a substitute.
controls.treatment: Keep the four Lens objectives. Do not replace them with a single health percentage.
controls.because: Lens targets are present: availability 0.995, latency 0.99, quality 0.95, safety 0.999.

controls.title: Safety evaluation
controls.statement: Safety is an SLO with a thin budget, watched on the same snapshot as quality, not a slide from last quarter.
controls.treatment: The safety objective is on a ticket. Clear the ticket or accept the partial in the pack. Do not mark it met while the status is ticket.
controls.because: Safety SLO is on a ticket (SLI 0.9974 vs 0.999, 6h burn 3.2x).

controls.title: Security evaluation
controls.statement: The gateway's DLP and tool blocks are evidence that security checks ran. A green chain with no blocks would only be partial.
controls.treatment: Keep request_blocked and tool_call_blocked in the exported slice. A log of only successes hides the control.
controls.because: The stub records DLP outcomes and at least one blocked request or tool call.

controls.title: Treatments documented
controls.statement: Every control in this catalog has a treatment a person can carry out. The decision gate is what shows the treatment is still loaded.
controls.treatment: If a treatment is "we will look at it", replace it with a model id, a rule id, or a request id.
controls.because: Every gap and partial in this pack has a treatment, and the decision gate passes.

controls.title: Post-deployment monitoring
controls.statement: After a model is active, the four SLOs keep running. A quiet availability line does not cancel a paging quality line.
controls.treatment: Page on quality stays visible next to the healthy latency line. Do not collapse them into one incident.
controls.because: Monitoring is on. Not quiet: quality, safety.
